question: Estimate the number of distributors required for a new D2C brand to launch into Tier 2 modern trade pan-India.
idealClarificationQuestions: D2C brand newly transitioning to offline modern trade — like Mamaearth in 2020, BoAt etc.? Yes.

calculationFlow: Tier 2 + Tier 3 city count for organized retail coverage: ~150.
